notablePrerequisites: Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice Ancient Den and return Darksteel Citadel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Darksteel Citadel enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Darksteel Citadel by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice Darksteel Citadel and return Ancient Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Ancient Den enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
